sentence: This project develops a gene delivery vector for the heart that is packed inside extracellular vesicles and resists neutralizing antibodies.
This project builds an assay that measures all human kinases at once and then uses it to screen a chemical library.
This project studies how a chemokine scavenger on tumor lymphatics controls immune cells moving into melanoma.
This project studies how an enzyme in the glutaminolysis pathway helps lung cancer resist immunotherapy.
This project builds deep learning pipelines that make synthetic chest radiograph data to help detect pathology more accurately.
This project studies immature subpopulations of tumor cells in rhabdomyosarcoma and how chemotherapy affects them.
This project tests whether methylglyoxal restores metabolic and transcriptional homeostasis in obesity and type 2 diabetes.
This project studies how stochastic switches help bacteria survive antibiotics and form aggregates.
This project studies how small cell lung cancer starts and progresses.
This project uses mass spectrometry to find the proteins in cancer tumors and the modifications on proteins involved in cell signaling.
This project builds DNA-based mechanoprobes and actuators to measure and control forces at cell-cell junctions.
This project studies how B cells contribute to immunity against tumors in head and neck cancer.
This project provides postmortem examinations and a bank of brain tissue from people with Alzheimer's disease and Lewy Body Disease for research.
This project holds a conference where scientists discuss virus structure, assembly and treatments that target viruses.
This project studies the molecular and cellular processes that form the cardiac neural crest in the developing heart.
This project tries to find out which cell and circuit changes lie behind two biomarkers of Alzheimer's disease.
This project builds human organoid models to study how transporter proteins move nutrients in the gut and mammary gland.
This project studies whether changing mitochondrial quality control in endothelial and smooth muscle cells of donor hearts improves transplant outcomes.
This project uses transgenic mice and lung tissues to study how overactive mechanistic target of rapamycin signaling remodels lung blood vessels.
This project builds a shared infrastructure for cancer research and pilot projects.
